reason: I can get full-page desktop and iPhone captures from a Playwright script on a cron in an afternoon, so I'd put one client site on the free tier and see how it does before paying for anything. Nine dollars isn't the problem. A brand-new tool with no reviews has to show me it's better than my own script first.
objection: Change alerts are almost always noise. Rotating hero sliders, dates, lazy-loaded images and ads all get flagged as changes. If the first two weeks of emails are false positives I'll mute them and forget the thing exists, cookie-banner hiding or not.
would_change_my_mind: A few weeks of free-tier alerts on a real client site that only flagged real changes, plus a branded before/after link a client actually found useful. That would make the Agency plan worth more than my script.
